token.label: Personal Access Token
token.description:
To obtain your personal token, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Airtable account.
2. Visit https://airtable.com/create/tokens/ to create one
3. Click on "+ Add a base" and select the base you want to use or all bases. To create new bases, also add the workspace under "+ Add a workspace".
4. Click on "+ Add a scope" and select "data.records:read", "data.records:write", "data.recordComments:read", "data.recordComments:write", "schema.bases:read" and "schema.bases:write" for full functionality.
5. Click on "Create token" and copy the token.

airtable_update_record.label: Update Record (Convert Values)
airtable_update_record.description: Changes the fields you fill in on an existing record.

recordId.label: Record ID

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Field values by field ID, such as {"fldXXXXXXXXXXXXXX": "Acme"}. An attachment field takes a file URL; select and linked-record fields take arrays.

airtable_clean_record.label: Clean Record
airtable_clean_record.description: Updates a record and empties every field you leave blank.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: Starts with rec. Copy it from the record URL or an earlier step.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Field values by field ID, such as {"fldXXXXXXXXXXXXXX": "Acme"}. A field given as empty is cleared.

airtable_delete_record.label: Delete Airtable Record
airtable_delete_record.description: Deletes a record from a table.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: Starts with rec. Copy it from the record URL or an earlier step.

airtable_add_comment_to_record.label: Add Comment to Record
airtable_add_comment_to_record.description: Adds a comment to an existing record.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: Starts with rec. Copy it from the record URL or an earlier step.

parentCommentId.label: Parent Comment ID
parentCommentId.description: Reply in this comment's thread. Empty: a new top-level comment.

tables.label: Tables
tables.description: Tables to create. The first field of each table is its primary field.

airtable_create_table.label: Create Table
airtable_create_table.description: Create a new table in an existing base.

description.label: Description
description.description: Shown under the table name in Airtable.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Fields for the table. The first one becomes the primary field.

airtable_find_base.label: Find Base
airtable_find_base.description: Find a base by its name or a keyword.

baseName.label: Base Name
baseName.description: Bases whose name contains this text are returned.

airtable_find_table_by_id.label: Find Table by ID
airtable_find_table_by_id.description: Get a table's details and schema using its ID.

airtable_get_record_by_id.label: Get Record by ID
airtable_get_record_by_id.description: Retrieve a single record from a table by its unique ID.

recordId.label: Record
recordId.description: Lists the first 100 records by their ID.

airtable_find_table.label: Find Table
airtable_find_table.description: Find a table in a given base by its name.

tableName.label: Table Name
tableName.description: Exact table name. Case does not matter.

airtable_get_base_schema.label: Get Base Schema
airtable_get_base_schema.description: Lists every table in a base with its fields and views.

create_record_ai.label: Create Record
create_record_ai.description: Adds a record to an Airtable table.

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

tableId.label: Table ID or Name
tableId.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: A JSON object mapping field names to values, e.g. {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}. Use Get Base Schema to learn field names and types. Linked-record and multi-select fields take arrays of ids/strings; attachment fields take an array of objects like [{"url": "https://..."}]. Values are sent with typecast enabled so plain strings are coerced where possible.

update_record_ai.label: Update Record (Exact Values)
update_record_ai.description: Update fields on an existing Airtable record by its ID.

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

tableId.label: Table ID or Name
tableId.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

record_id.label: Record ID
record_id.description: The record ID (e.g. "recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with Search Records or List Records.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: A JSON object mapping field names to new values, e.g. {"Status": "Done"}. Only the keys you supply are changed; pass null to clear a field. Linked-record and multi-select fields take arrays of ids/strings; attachment fields take an array of objects like [{"url": "https://..."}]. Use Get Base Schema to learn field names and types.

list_records.label: List Records
list_records.description: List or query records in an Airtable table.

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

tableId.label: Table ID or Name
tableId.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

filter_by_formula.label: Filter By Formula
filter_by_formula.description: Optional Airtable formula to filter rows, e.g. {Status}="Done" or AND({Score}>5, FIND("ace", LOWER({Name}))). Field names go in {curly braces}.

view.label: View
view.description: Optional view ID or name to restrict and order results to that view.

max_records.label: Max Records
max_records.description: Optional maximum total number of records to return; the action paginates across pages up to this number. Omit to return just the first page (with an offset cursor to continue).

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: Optional number of records per page (1-100, default 100).

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Optional JSON array of sort directives, e.g. [{"field": "Name", "direction": "asc"}]. Direction is "asc" or "desc".

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Optional list of field names to return; omit to return all fields.

list_bases.label: List Bases
list_bases.description: List all Airtable bases the token can access.

upload_attachment_ai.label: Upload Attachment
upload_attachment_ai.description: Upload a file into an attachment field on a record.

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

record_id.label: Record ID
record_id.description: The record ID (e.g. "recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") to attach the file to.

attachment_field_id.label: Attachment Field ID
attachment_field_id.description: The field ID (e.g. "fldXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") of a multiple-attachments column. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (pick a field whose type is multipleAttachments).

file.label: File (Base64)
file.description: The file content encoded as a base64 string (no data: prefix).

content_type.label: Content Type
content_type.description: The MIME type of the file, e.g. 'image/png' or 'application/pdf'.

filename.label: File Name
filename.description: Optional name for the file as it should appear after upload.

airtable_upload_file_to_column.label: Upload File to Column
airtable_upload_file_to_column.description: Uploads a file to an attachment field of a record.

attachment_column.label: Attachment Column
attachment_column.description: The field ID (fldXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) of an attachment field. Get Base Schema lists the fields of type multipleAttachments.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: Starts with rec. Copy it from the record URL or an earlier step.

file.label: File
file.description: A file from an earlier step.

file_content_type.label: File Content Type
file_content_type.description: MIME type of the file, such as image/png.

filename.label: File Name
filename.description: Name shown in Airtable. Empty: the uploaded file's own name.

airtable_upload_file_to_column.beforeRequest:
if (!('filename' in request.body)) request.body.filename = inputs.file;
return request;

upsert_records.label: Upsert Records
upsert_records.description: Create or update up to 10 records in one batch call.

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

tableId.label: Table ID or Name
tableId.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

records.label: Records
records.description: A JSON array of up to 10 records, each shaped {"fields": {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}}. To update an existing record without merge keys, include its id: {"id": "recXXXX", "fields": {...}}. Use Get Base Schema for field names.

fields_to_merge_on.label: Fields To Merge On
fields_to_merge_on.description: Optional list of field names used as the match key for upsert, e.g. ["Email"]. When set, records matching on these fields are updated, others created. Leave empty for a plain batch update by id.

typecast.label: Typecast
typecast.description: When true (default), Airtable coerces string values to the field type and auto-creates select options. Set false for strict typing.

upsert_records.beforeRequest: const body = request.body; const records = body.records; if (!Array.isArray(records) || records.length === 0) throw new Error('Records must be a non-empty JSON array.'); if (records.length > 10) throw new Error('Airtable accepts at most 10 records per upsert call; received ' + records.length + '. Split into batches of 10.'); if (body.typecast === undefined) body.typecast = true; if (!(body.performUpsert.fieldsToMergeOn || []).length) delete body.performUpsert; return request;
upsert_records.afterResponse: return {records: response.records, count: response.records.length, createdRecords: response.createdRecords ?? [], updatedRecords: response.updatedRecords ?? []};

delete_records_batch.label: Delete Records Batch
delete_records_batch.description: Delete up to 10 records by ID in one call.

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

tableId.label: Table ID or Name
tableId.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

record_ids.label: Record IDs
record_ids.description: A list of up to 10 record IDs to delete, e.g. ["recAAA", "recBBB"]. Resolve IDs with Search Records or List Records.

delete_records_batch.beforeRequest: const ids = JSON.parse(inputs.record_ids); if (!Array.isArray(ids) || ids.length === 0) throw new Error('Record IDs must be a non-empty list.'); if (ids.length > 10) throw new Error('Airtable deletes at most 10 records per call; received ' + ids.length + '. Split into batches of 10.'); ids.forEach((id, index) => { request.query['records[' + index + ']'] = id; }); return request;

get_current_user.label: Get Current User
get_current_user.description: Get the connected token identity and its scopes.

search_records.label: Search Records
search_records.description: Find records where a field matches a value.

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

tableId.label: Table ID or Name
tableId.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

search_field.label: Search Field
search_field.description: The exact name of the field to match against. Resolve names with Get Base Schema.

search_value.label: Search Value
search_value.description: The value to look for in the search field.

match_mode.label: Match Mode
match_mode.description: "contains" (default) does a case-sensitive substring match; "exact" requires the whole field to equal the value. Exact compares the field as text, so it also matches number and checkbox fields by their text value.

view.label: View
view.description: Optional view ID or name to restrict the search to.

max_records.label: Max Records
max_records.description: Optional maximum number of matching records to return.

update_table.label: Update Table

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

tableId.label: Table ID or Name
tableId.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

name.label: New Name
name.description: Optional new name for the table.

description.label: New Description
description.description: Optional new description for the table.

update_table.beforeRequest: if (!inputs.name && !inputs.description) throw new Error('Supply at least one of New Name or New Description.'); return request;

create_field.label: Create Field
create_field.description: Add a new field (column) to a table.

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

tableId.label: Table ID or Name
tableId.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

name.label: Field Name
name.description: The name for the new field.

type.label: Field Type
type.description: A valid Airtable field type, e.g. "singleLineText", "number", "singleSelect", "multipleSelects", "date", "checkbox", "multipleRecordLinks".

options.label: Options
options.description: Type-specific options as JSON. Required for select fields, e.g. {"choices": [{"name": "Todo"}, {"name": "Done"}]}; for number {"precision": 0}. Omit for simple text fields.

update_field.label: Update Field

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

tableId.label: Table ID
tableId.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") — this endpoint requires the ID, not the name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

field_id.label: Field ID
field_id.description: The field ID (e.g. "fldXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") to update. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

name.label: New Name
name.description: Optional new name for the field.

description.label: New Description
description.description: Optional new description for the field.

update_field.beforeRequest: if (!inputs.name && !inputs.description) throw new Error('Supply at least one of New Name or New Description.'); return request;

list_record_comments.label: List Record Comments

base.label: Base ID
base.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases.

tableId.label: Table ID or Name
tableId.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema.

record_id.label: Record ID
record_id.description: The record ID (e.g. "recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") whose comments to list.

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: Optional number of comments per page (max 100).

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Optional pagination offset returned by a previous call to fetch the next page.

list_record_comments.afterResponse: return {comments: response.comments, count: response.comments.length, offset: response.offset ?? null};

new_record.label: New Record
new_record.description: Triggers when a new record is added to the selected table.

viewId.label: View
viewId.description: Only records in this view are used. Empty: the whole table.
